name: Noachian-Almagest
description: An ocean of dust without banks. At the edge of sight, past dust seas stretching to the horizon, mirage-cities rise and collapse by noon, and the light turns brutal and white.
In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless. Mats of pigment-bearing microbes stain the wet stone in bands of rust and violet.
Core samples from the deep crust contain isotopes with no known decay chain. The samples are stored off-world now, and studied reluctantly.
For traders, copper and solar potential alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
